zh.title: 印度FLY91與ATR簽署40架ATR72-600購機協議
zh.summary: FLY91訂購40架ATR 72-600客機；預計2027年起交付；總額10億美元
body: 印度區域航空公司FLY91與民航機製造商ATR宣佈達成一項包含40架ATR 72-600型雙發渦輪螺旋槳客機的確定訂單，交易金額估計約為10億美元。此項協議為ATR近十載以來所獲的最大筆確定訂單，同時亦創下區域航空公司歷來採購該廠牌機型的最大規模紀錄。
根據交付規劃，首批客機預計於2027年至2032年間陸續交付。目前僅營運6架客機的FLY91計畫在未來5年內，將旗下機隊規模拓展至60架。新增的訂單亦將ATR於2026年的年度訂單總數推升至54架，超過去年全年的淨訂單總數。
FLY91創辦人、董事總經理兼執行長Manoj Chacko表示，此項40架客機的採購案為航空公司下一階段擴張的重要催化劑。他指出，在製造商交付新機之前，公司亦計畫先從現有二手市場租賃6至8架ATR客機，目標是在明年底前將機隊擴充至12至14架，以建立更完整的區域航網。
印度民航局長Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu指出，區域聯絡網為印度航空業成長的基本支柱，將較小城市與主要經濟中心連結為國家優先要務。隨著政府推動「UDAN 2.0」區域航線補貼計畫，此規模的投資將有助於將更多二級與三級城市納入國家經濟主流。
FLY91目前每週營運逾280個航班，串聯包括馬哈拉施特拉邦、卡納塔克邦及喀拉拉邦等多個省份的13個航點。隨著新客機陸續加入營運，該公司期望進一步提升印度區域航空的運力與連結度。

en.title: FLY91 Places Firm Order for 40 ATR 72-600 Turboprops Worth $1 Billion
en.summary: FLY91 orders 40 ATR 72-600 turboprops valued at $1 billion; deliveries scheduled from 2027 to 2032.
body: Indian regional carrier FLY91 has signed a firm order with aircraft manufacturer ATR for 40 ATR 72-600 turboprop aircraft in a deal valued at approximately $1 billion. The agreement represents the largest firm order for ATR in nearly a decade and the largest ever placed by a regional airline.

Deliveries of the new turboprops are scheduled to take place between 2027 and 2032. FLY91, which currently operates a fleet of six aircraft, aims to expand its total fleet to 60 aircraft over the next five years. The order lifts ATR’s cumulative order intake for 2026 to 54 aircraft, surpassing its total net orders for all of 2025.

Manoj Chacko, Founder, Managing Director, and CEO of FLY91, described the 40-aircraft purchase as the catalyst for the airline's next phase of expansion. Prior to receiving the direct deliveries from ATR, the airline plans to lease another six to eight ATR aircraft from the existing market, potentially increasing its fleet to between 12 and 14 aircraft by late next year.

India’s Union Minister for Civil Aviation Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu highlighted that regional connectivity remains a fundamental pillar of the country’s aviation growth strategy. He noted that investments of this magnitude in regional capacity will play a crucial role as the government rolls out its UDAN 2.0 regional connectivity program to integrate more tier 2 and tier 3 cities into the national economy.

FLY91 currently operates more than 280 weekly flights serving 13 regional destinations across India. The carrier seeks to leverage the operational economics of the ATR 72-600 to provide direct and affordable air services connecting emerging economic hubs and regional communities.

zh.title: 大韓航空與泰國航空工業簽署軍機維修合作協議
zh.summary: 大韓航空與泰國航空工業合作；維修泰國黑鷹直升機；推動技術培訓
body: 大韓航空於2026年9月2日在釜山科技中心與泰國國營的泰國航空工業（TAI）簽署協議，針對泰國軍用飛機的維修與檢修展開戰略合作。
根據協議，雙方首要合作項目為泰國陸軍UH-60黑鷹直升機的廠級維修，未來計劃擴大至泰國皇家武裝部隊營運的其他軍用機型。大韓航空亦將協助泰國航空工業標準化軍機維修流程，並為泰國人員提供技術培訓。
大韓航空航太部門自1991年起生產UH-60直升機，累積了豐富的維修支援經驗，迄今已完成超過5500架飛機的廠級維修與性能提升作業。

en.title: Korean Air Partners with Thai Aviation Industries for Military Aircraft MRO
en.summary: Korean Air signed a partnership with Thai Aviation Industries to maintain military aircraft including UH-60 helicopters.
body: Korean Air has signed a strategic partnership agreement with Thailand's state-owned Thai Aviation Industries on September 2, 2026, at the Tech Center in Busan. The agreement focuses on collaboration in maintenance, repair, and overhaul services for military aircraft operated in Thailand.

Under the initial scope of the agreement, both entities will cooperate on depot-level maintenance for the Royal Thai Army's UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters. The partnership is expected to expand to other military aircraft flown by the Royal Thai Armed Forces. Korean Air will also assist Thai Aviation Industries in standardizing maintenance processes and providing technical training.
Korean Air's aerospace division began producing UH-60 helicopters in 1991. The company has performed depot-level maintenance and performance upgrades for more than 5,500 aircraft.

zh.title: 法官駁回俄羅斯索回多倫多遭扣押安124貨機申請
zh.summary: 加拿大法官駁回俄羅斯索回多倫多遭扣押安124貨機的申請
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，一名法官已駁回俄羅斯要求索回其在多倫多遭扣押的安托諾夫 An-124 貨機之申請。這架巨大的貨運飛機屬於俄羅斯籍的包機與空中貨運專門業者伏爾加-第聶伯航空（Volga-Dnepr Airlines）。
自2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭至今，該架飛機已被困在多倫多皮爾遜國際機場（YYZ）長達四年半之久。在加拿大政府因該起入侵事件對俄羅斯籍飛機關閉領空之後，這架貨機在抵達加拿大時便隨即遭到滯留，無法離境。

en.title: Judge Rejects Russia's Bid to Reclaim Seized Antonov An-124 in Toronto
en.summary: A judge rejected Russia's bid to reclaim a Volga-Dnepr Airlines Antonov An-124 stranded in Toronto.
body: According to an aviation news report by Simple Flying, a judge has rejected Russia's legal bid to reclaim an Antonov An-124 cargo jet that was seized and remains stranded in Toronto. The massive cargo aircraft belongs to Volga-Dnepr Airlines, a Russian charter and airfreight specialist.

The cargo plane has been stuck at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) for the four and a half years that have elapsed since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022. It was stranded immediately upon its arrival in Canada after the nation closed its airspace to Russian aircraft.
